Interface TypeHierarchyRecord

public sealed interface TypeHierarchyRecord
What the record of the generic hierarchy of a type says and leaves out, as reported by VisitorContext.recordTypeHierarchy(ClassElement, Element...) when the record is written. The record itself is found at run time with TypeHierarchies.find(Class).

5.3.0
